sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The Rogelio Salmona Foundation invites submissions for the Fifth Cycle of the Rogelio Salmona Latin American Architecture Prize. Under the theme “Spaces that Bring Us Together,” the Prize seeks to recognize architectural works that have contributed to transforming collective life and the relationships between people and the places they inhabit. The call invites submissions of architectural works built between 2010 and 2020 in Latin America and the Caribbean that, through their open spaces and connections to the city, have contributed to the social transformation of their surroundings.
